checks.name: head vs frame at (-18.2, 16.2), z 5.25-16.75
checks.criterion: exposed gap constant (<= 0.1 variation), always < 2.0, or always >= 12 (SPEC V12)
checks.kind: finger-size opening closes by >= 2 mm to a gap inside the 2-12 mm band (squeeze)
checks.proposed_fix: The sculpted head's edge is the sculpt's organic outline, not an arc about P: as it swings, the gap between it and the static sculpt beside it (chin corners against the chest and the yarn ball's flank, the back of the head against the recess its sweep cuts in the cushion) opens to ~r x 2 psi_b on the trailing side and closes on the leading side.  Where a fingertip reaches it, make that part of the head's edge a circular arc about P over the whole swing (its distance from any fixed point is then constant, and the recess wall cut by its sweep becomes the concentric arc + gap_xy), e.g. trim the chin corners to an arc about P; or keep the gap out of the probe's reach (recess < ~2 mm deep) or < 2.0 at every pose.

checks.kind: literal V12 violation only: the gap never opens to a 4 mm fingertip or changes by < 2 mm
checks.proposed_fix: Cap vs static ring: the seam r cap_r / cap_r + cap_gap cuts a sculpted surface that is not axisymmetric, so at a fixed height the cap's section comes and goes as it turns and the gap at a point varies around 1-2 mm (never a fingertip opening).  A level rim (the cap's and the ring's top flattened to a common height for ~1 mm on both sides of the seam) makes it constant 0.5.
